name: io.github.tonyyang0504/kogan-mcp
description: Kogan Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KOGAN_SELLER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: SellerToken (API key) issued by your Kogan Marketplace account manager after the marketplace application is approved (UAT and production keys differ); sent as the SellerToken header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KOGAN_SELLER_ID
environmentVariables.description: SellerID (your Kogan marketplace account name) issued with the token; sent as the SellerID header.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_KOGAN_API_HOST
environmentVariables.description: nimda.kogan.com for production, or nimda-marketplace.aws.kgn.io for the UAT test environment; calls go to https://<api_host>/api/marketplace/v2/...
